description: Installation of physical and electronic security measures around the site
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SEMD Kempton WTW Heritage Statement prepared by Atkins, DW01F03 - Method Statement, Kempton Park TWT Pump House Listed Building Security Works dated 12/06/2019, C913-CJ-KEMPW1ZZ-BLDSC-DR-C-0100 Rev P01, C913-CJ-KEMPW1ZZ-BLDSC-DR-C-0099 Rev P01, C913-CJ-KEMPW1ZZ-BLDSC-DR-C-0097 Rev P03, C913-CJ-KEMPW1ZZ-BLDSC-DR-C-0019 Rev P03, C913-CJ-KEMPW1ZZ-BLDSC-DR-C-0016 Rev P06, C913-CJ-KEMPW1ZZ-BLDSC-DR-C-0015 Rev P03, C913-CJ-KEMPW1ZZ-BLDSC-DR-C-0010 Rev P07, C913 SEMD Rev A, Photographs, Unnumbered Location Plan received 23/09/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to method used and to colour textile and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by condition attached to this consent.
